description:
The main characters, Himari Aozora and Mitsuki Hoshikawa, enter Paradise Private Academy.
Himari, who aspires for AIPRI, dreams of making 10,000 friends! But for the shy and anxious Himari, it might be a bit difficult...

Himari unexpectedly makes her AIPRI debut!?

She has a "secret" she can't even tell her best friend, Mitsuki! But it seems that Mitsuki has a "secret" of her own...

Secret-bearers Himari and Mitsuki's AIPRI begins!!

(Source: Official Website, translated)

node.description: Full of positive energy, she is a first-year junior high school student at Paradise Private Academy who dreams of making 10,000 friends. Although she is energetic and positive, she is shy and a crybaby. When it comes to dodgeball, she is the last to get out of the game.

Mitsuki is a cool and serious first-year junior high school student at Paradise Private Academy, and is Himari's childhood friend and dorm mate. She is skilled at playing the piano and baking sweets, and terrified of ghosts.
Sakura is a strong-willed but caring second-year student and the student council president at Paradise Private Academy. She is admired by everyone at the Academy. She is good at chess.

A second-year student and vice president of the student council at Paradise Private Academy. She is always calm and elegant. She is knowledgeable about fashion and leads the school as its fashion leader.

A second-year student at Paradise Private Academy. She serves as the treasurer of the student council, never missing a single business opportunity. Her specialty is programming, and she excels at creating useful gadgets.

A second-year student at Paradise Private Academy who has a slightly sharp tongue. She excels in data analysis and serves as the secretary of the student council. It makes her happy to see neatly arranged numbers. She is rumored to be good at fortune-telling, but whether the rumors are true or not remains a mystery.
A confident first-year student at Paradise Private Academy who hates giving up. She is very experienced when it comes to AiPri. She is skilled at playing the guitar and loves rock music.

Meganee is one of the supporting characters in PriPara and a staff member at Prism Stone. There is more than one of her active in PriPara. She seems to be a cheery, kind, and friendly person. She is a helpful, supportive character.

(Source: PriPara Wikia)

A student in class 1-A at Paradise Private Academy and classmate of Himari and Mitsuki.

She admires Katsushika Hokusai because he started out as a loner and rose to success to become a world-famous painter. She posts illustrations on social media under the handle name, Katsushika Yukosai, which comes from his name.

Dark Chii was born out of Chii's desperation and hopelessness in episode 40, aswell as Tsumugi's AiPri Princess awakening altering the AiPri Verse system. Her goal is to make AiPri "less boring" by sinking it into darkness.

She is not Chii, but rather a different being that looks like her.

name.native: フェザーグランプリコーデ

node.description:
A girl being called "Princess" who lives in a palace that appeared in the AiPri-Verse. She appears to hold a secret somehow related to the AiPri Contest and the new Buzzrium Change...?

(Source: Takara Tomy Arts, translated)

An outgoing and friendly first-year middle school student at Paradise Private Academy. She's an AiPri model who has recently gained popularity and tends to refer to things with a "Buzz..." prefix.

(Source: Takara Tomy Arts, translated)

A shy and quiet first-year middle school student at Paradise Private Academy. In secret to everyone, she's writing her own novels on AiPriGram.

(Source: Takara Tomy Arts, translated)

Managed by his older sister, [Oto P](https://anilist.co/character/356237/), he's a very popular AiPri as a prince-like character. But in reality, he's a more laid back character preferring to do things at his own pace.

(Source: Takara Tomy Arts, translated)

[Subaru's](https://anilist.co/character/356236) older sister. She's a reliable person and is managing her younger brother's AiPri activities perfectly. She's known as "Oto P" among the PriTomo, but it appears she herself won't be making her AiPri debut...?

(Source: Takara Tomy Arts, translated)

A first-year middle school student at Paradise Private Academy who rushes recklessly into any challenge. She loves animals a bit too much, to the point where she might even end her sentences with animal sounds?! She looks up to [Chii](https://anilist.co/character/327545).

(Source: Takara Tomy Arts, translated)
